summary: Dalrada Technology Group filed an 8-K reporting a Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release, effective October 2, 2026, resolving a disputed financing default asserted by IBS Equity Fund III and IBS Private Credit Fund IV under a 2025 master standby letter of credit, credit, security and account purchase facility that never funded. Dalrada paid a single $20,000 lump sum, extinguishing roughly $1,162,246 in asserted fees and charges. All financing documents, guaranties, pledges, the secured promissory note and pre-funded warrant terminated, and no funding commitment survives. This is a dispute settlement, not a special-situation transaction; no board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for residual litigation, going-concern and liquidity disclosures.
